mapper.update: INSERT INTO WH_SYS_ALERT_SETTING (SETTING_KEY, SETTING_VALUE, UPDATED_BY, UPDATED_DATE) VALUES (#{SETTING_KEY}, #{SETTING_VALUE}, #{UPDATED_BY}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE SETTING_VALUE = VALUES(SETTING_VALUE), UPDATED_BY = VALUES(UPDATED_BY), UPDATED_DATE = NOW()
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO WH_SYS_ALERT (ALERT_KEY, SEVERITY, STATUS, TITLE, MESSAGE, METRIC_VALUE, PLATFORM_ID, OPENED_DATE, UPDATED_DATE) VALUES (#{ALERT_KEY}, #{SEVERITY}, 'OPEN', #{TITLE}, #{MESSAGE}, #{METRIC_VALUE}, #{PLATFORM_ID}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE WH_SYS_ALERT SET STATUS = 'RESOLVED', RESOLVED_DATE = NOW(), METRIC_VALUE = #{METRIC_VALUE}, UPDATED_DATE = NOW() WHERE ALERT_ID = #{ALERT_ID} AND STATUS = 'OPEN'
UPDATE WH_SYS_ALERT SET ACK_YN = 'Y', ACK_BY = #{ACK_BY}, ACK_DATE = NOW(), UPDATED_DATE = NOW() WHERE ALERT_ID = #{ALERT_ID} AND ACK_YN = 'N'
mapper.sql: ALERT_ID, ALERT_KEY, SEVERITY, STATUS, TITLE, MESSAGE, METRIC_VALUE, PLATFORM_ID, OPENED_DATE, UPDATED_DATE, RESOLVED_DATE, ACK_YN, ACK_BY, ACK_DATE, MAIL_SENT_YN, NOTIFY_COUNT, LAST_NOTIFIED_DATE, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(OPENED_DATE) * 1000 AS OPENED_MS, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, OPENED_DATE, IFNULL(RESOLVED_DATE, NOW())) AS DURATION_MIN
mapper.select: SELECT FROM WH_SYS_ALERT WHERE STATUS = 'OPEN' ORDER BY FIELD(SEVERITY, 'CRITICAL', 'DANGER', 'WARNING'), OPENED_DATE DESC
SELECT FROM WH_SYS_ALERT ORDER BY ALERT_ID DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO WH_SYS_ALERT_EVENT (ALERT_ID, ALERT_KEY, EVENT_TYPE, SEVERITY, MESSAGE, ACTOR, CREATED_DATE) VALUES (#{ALERT_ID, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{ALERT_KEY, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{EVENT_TYPE}, #{SEVERITY, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{MESSAGE, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{ACTOR, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT EVENT_ID, ALERT_ID, ALERT_KEY, EVENT_TYPE, SEVERITY, MESSAGE, ACTOR, CREATED_DATE FROM WH_SYS_ALERT_EVENT ORDER BY EVENT_ID DESC LIMIT #{limit}
